items.title: BRS sends legal notice to Telugu daily over claims of water diversion to KCR’s farmhouse
items.summary: The Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) has sent a legal notice to the Telugu newspaper Velugu, owned by Congress Minister Gaddam Vivek Venkatswamy, over a story alleging that water from the Kondapochamma Sagar Reservoir has been diverted to former Chief Minister K Chandrashekar Rao’s farmhouse in Erravalli village of Siddipet district. Accusing Velugu of publishing a false story against KCR, the BRS legal cell has demanded an unconditional apology to be carried on the front page, warning that the newspaper’s editor and management would otherwise face a defamation suit. The report published in Velugu on October 17 included images of a three-acre well filled with water allegedly part of KCR’s farmhouse.
